A Beastlord is a savage hybrid who combines melee combat, spiritual magic, and a loyal warder companion. - EQLegends = Description = [[File:C_beastlord.gif|right]] Beastlords are a hybrid melee and spellcasting class that fight alongside a permanent animal companion. They combine respectable melee damage, utility magic, and pet support into a flexible role that can adapt to many situations. === Class Titles === In the original [[Kunark]] expansion, classes would gain new titles at levels over 50. In EverQuest Legends, these titles are not available, and it is unknown how they will be presented. While they may be available with future level cap increases, they are included here only for posterity: {| class="eoTable2" ! Level 1-50 ! Level 51-54 ! Level 55-59 ! Level 60 |- style="text-align: center;" |Beastlord || Primalist || Animist || Feral Lord |} = Creation Guide = == Picking the Right Race == When creating a character you must first select your primary race. This race will be locked in at level 11, and can't be changed until you unlock other races. Below are the race options for this class, as well as their stat line. When selecting a race, a big consideration is the factions it is associate with and opposed to. There may also be some racial benefits or penalties to consider as well.
